Hourglass shaped mechanism - The method of triggering the mechanism is very simple, and people with some knowledge of physics may be able to do it. There are two heating points on the mechanism. As long as a candle is lit and placed below the heating point, the thermal barrier of the material will shrink, which will push the opening and closing of the funnel valve, causing sediment to leak downwards. Moreover, the faucet above the pit will keep dripping water to ensure that the leaked sediment has a certain viscosity. The heating point is also equipped with a small balance. When the weight of the candle burns and decreases, the balance becomes unbalanced, causing the candle to rise, ensuring that the heating point will continue to heat.
